source_basis: Fourteen producer-authored decision questions frozen in a dedicated commit before any Cycle 415 retrieval adapter or score was implemented. They are derived from accepted Cycle 373-386 decision boundaries and are not independent, protected, or evidence of later use.

seed_reconciliation.reason: The prior supported XHS observation was about eighteen minutes old and inside the six-hour cadence; no public-lane or accepted-result trigger changed.

cases.query: I need to cite tool-client results as client-only causality. Which accepted record explains why matched rows are insufficient?
Can a smaller-model skill result support a scale claim when the optimization method also changed and the public artifact omits the headline numbers?
Which accepted result warns that transfer evidence bundles two interventions and has no repeated-run uncertainty?
Which runtime benchmark record says an unavailable repository and thirty-one tasks cannot establish general impossibility?
Where is the warning that manuscript and released summary counts disagree and that replay saturation is distinct from grouping?
Which record limits partial recovery of hidden reasoning to the tested task rather than general monitorability or zero-information evidence?
Which verification result depends on structured oracle classes and lacks a deployed cost comparison?
Where is catalog rejection arithmetic separated from real violation recall, with implementation and zone assignments still absent?
Which code-review study cannot estimate all-comment user impact because its labels are selected through developer replies?
Which selective-prediction result uses post-hoc abstention thresholds and lacks a finite-sample guarantee at low coverage?
Which test-time training record says selected means do not isolate token weighting or causally establish competence preservation?
Where does one simulator misranking support multi-resolution audit without establishing a universal repair law?
Which self-evolution comparison jointly changes model, harness, proposer, and budget and has no attributable release?
Which replication project has a public release that omits benchmark trajectories and results and differs from the paper grader boundary?
